newsitem.title: MEXICO: BOXING-MEXICO'S LOPEZ NAMED WBC BOXER OF THE YEAR.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-MEXICO'S LOPEZ NAMED WBC BOXER OF THE YEAR.

text.p: The World Boxing Council unanimously named Mexican Ricardo Lopez boxer of the year after he defended his strawweight title four times in 1996, winning all the fights by knockouts.
Lopez has never lost a fight in 12 years of professional boxing and has succesfully defended his title 18 times, "a new world record for the lighter weights," the WBC said in a statement.

Oscar De la Hoya of the United States won an honourable mention for stripping Mexican boxing legend Julio Cesar Chavez of his super lightweight title in June, in what was also described as the most dramatic fight of the year.

The WBC named as fight of the year Evander Holyfield's stunning defeat of Mike Tyson in November to win the World Boxing Association's heavyweight championship. It noted that the fight between the two Americans was "one of the great surprises" in boxing history.
The year's boxing revelation, the WBC said, was featherweight Luisito Espinosa of the Philippines, who fended off three challenges to his crown.
His knockout defeat of Mexico's Cobrita Gonzalez in Mexico got a special mention.
